data.name: Damned
data.description: When you are killed, your soul is instantly sent to Hell. Any character attempting to resurrect you must succeed at a caster level check vs. DC %1 or her spell fails. That character cannot attempt to resurrect you again until the following day, though other characters can attempt as they please.|DiabolistDamnedDC
